destinations.title: Puerto Banús
destinations.intro: The natural base for Marbella Boat Charter: fast access to the Golden Mile, Marbella Bay and westbound routes toward Estepona and Sotogrande.
destinations.best: Most private motor-yacht departures, luxury day charters and short sunset programmes.

destinations.title: Marbella
destinations.intro: Marbella Bay combines coastline views, easy swim stops and direct access to the city from the sea.
destinations.best: Coastal escapes, dolphin-search routes, group boats and easy half-day charters.

destinations.title: Estepona
destinations.intro: A useful westbound charter area for clients staying around Estepona or looking to explore a quieter stretch of the Costa del Sol.
destinations.best: Full-day motor-yacht charters and flexible westbound itineraries.

destinations.title: Sotogrande
destinations.intro: A natural staging point for longer western itineraries, with a marina culture that matches premium private charter.
destinations.best: Full-day charter, corporate hospitality and routes toward Gibraltar.

destinations.title: Gibraltar
destinations.intro: A longer-route charter that turns the day into a destination journey, with weather, vessel range and timing becoming central to planning.
destinations.best: Larger motor yachts and full-day / extended programmes.

destinations.title: Morocco by sea
destinations.intro: Selected longer charters can cross the Strait toward the north coast of Morocco when the vessel, weather and operational plan make sense.
destinations.best: Extended or multi-day planning only; always subject to operational confirmation.

experiences.title: Luxury yacht cruising
experiences.intro: A polished private day on the Mediterranean: cruise the coast, stop to swim, relax on deck and shape the day around the group.

experiences.title: Sunset charter
experiences.intro: A shorter late-afternoon departure built around light, atmosphere and an easy return to port.

experiences.title: Dolphin watching
experiences.intro: A coastal/offshore search programme where sightings are never guaranteed but the route is planned around local experience and current conditions.

experiences.title: Sport fishing
experiences.intro: Bottom fishing or big-game trolling with professional fishing boats, tackle and crew.

experiences.title: Day sailing
experiences.intro: A monohull or catamaran day for guests who value sailing itself, quieter cruising and a more tactile connection with wind and sea.

experiences.title: Stag & hen charters
experiences.intro: Private boat time for celebrations, with catering, drinks and event details coordinated around the group and vessel.

experiences.title: Corporate & group events
experiences.intro: Team-building regattas, fishing competitions, multi-yacht cruising and larger group events coordinated as one programme.

experiences.title: Gibraltar charter
experiences.intro: A longer westbound route where vessel selection, sea state and time on passage matter as much as the destination.

experiences.title: Morocco by yacht
experiences.intro: A destination-led charter across the Strait for suitable vessels and conditions, planned individually with the charter team.

services.title: Yacht management & maintenance
services.intro: For owners who want the yacht kept ready, documented and professionally cared for without employing a full-time captain year-round.

services.title: Yacht catering
services.intro: Food and drink options coordinated around the vessel, charter duration and group, with advance notice required for larger or tailored menus.

services.title: Boat rental Marbella
services.intro: A commercial landing page for clients searching for boat hire in Marbella, connected directly to the live fleet and charter planner.

services.title: Yacht charter Marbella
services.intro: Premium private yacht charter across Marbella and Puerto Banús, with vessel selection matched to group size, route and desired level of service.

services.title: Sailboat rental Marbella
services.intro: Crewed monohull and catamaran sailing from Puerto Banús for half-day, full-day and selected longer programmes.
